description: macOS desktop app for design inspiration, built with Tauri + React

stories.title: Setup Welcome/Library Selection Screen
stories.description: Create the initial screen shown when no library is open. Should allow creating a new library or opening an existing .inspo folder. Use a clean, minimal design with the app's warm aesthetic.
acceptance_criteria: Shows when app launches with no library
Button to create new library (triggers native folder picker)
Proper error handling for invalid library paths

stories.title: Resizable Sidebar with Folder Tree
stories.description: Implement the sidebar with All Items, Favorites, Trash sections, and a collapsible folder tree. Sidebar should be resizable with drag handle.
acceptance_criteria: Fixed sections: All Items, Favorites, Trash
Drag handle to resize sidebar (min 180px, max 400px)

stories.title: Item Grid View with Thumbnails
stories.description: Display items in a responsive grid with thumbnail previews. Support different item types (images, bookmarks) with appropriate visual treatment.
acceptance_criteria: Thumbnail images load from Tauri asset protocol
Different card styles for images vs bookmarks

stories.title: Item Selection (Single, Multi, Range)
stories.description: Implement item selection patterns: click to select, Cmd+click for multi-select, Shift+click for range select.
acceptance_criteria: Shift+click selects range from last selected

stories.title: Drag & Drop Import from Finder
stories.description: Allow dragging files from Finder into the app to import them. Show drop zone visual feedback.
acceptance_criteria: Drop zone appears when dragging files over app
Accepts image files (png, jpg, gif, webp)

stories.title: URL/Bookmark Import Dialog
stories.description: Dialog for importing URLs as bookmarks. Fetches metadata and creates bookmark item.
acceptance_criteria: Shows loading state while fetching metadata

stories.title: Item Detail Panel
stories.description: Slide-out or sidebar panel showing selected item details: preview, metadata, tags, and actions.

stories.title: Context Menu for Items
stories.description: Right-click context menu on items with common actions.

stories.title: Search with Full-Text Search
stories.description: Search bar that queries the SQLite FTS5 index for items matching title/description.

stories.title: Filter by Type and Tags
stories.description: Filter controls to show only images, only bookmarks, or items with specific tags.

stories.title: Sort Options
stories.description: Dropdown to sort items by date, name, or type.
acceptance_criteria: Sort by: Date Added, Name, Type

stories.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
stories.description: Implement common keyboard shortcuts for navigation and actions.

stories.title: Folder CRUD UI
stories.description: UI for creating, renaming, and deleting folders in the sidebar.

stories.title: Tag Management UI
stories.description: Interface for creating, editing, and deleting tags. Tags shown in sidebar.

stories.title: Trash Management
stories.description: Trash view with restore and permanent delete options.
acceptance_criteria: Restore button moves back to original folder
